end.summary: Harsh practised reading and plotting points from ordered pairs (x, y).
end.parentNote: Asha practised plotting by moving along the x-axis first, then the y-axis, and identifying quadrants from the signs. Harsh correctly described the different locations of (3, 2) and (2, 3) after counting the movements, so that mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. The sign-change mix-up remained: changing (-2, 4) to (2, 4) changes the point, so at home, ask Harsh to plot both points on a small grid and compare them.
